risk_if_not_implemented: Without Hybrid / Composite Cryptography, data in transit and at rest may be exposed through weak, misconfigured or compromised cryptographic protections. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Long-Term Confidentiality Loss from Cryptographic Obsolescence (R-IP-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Use of Cryptographic Controls
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of cryptographic protections controls using known public standards and trusted cryptographic technologies.
compensating_control_1.justification: Use of Cryptographic Controls (CRY-02) provides cryptographic protection and key governance that compensates for the absence of Hybrid / Composite Cryptography (QTS-09.9) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative or complementary cryptographic mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cryptographic Key Management
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate cryptographic key management controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of keys.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cryptographic Key Management (CRY-10) provides cryptographic protection and key governance that compensates for the absence of Hybrid / Composite Cryptography (QTS-09.9) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative or complementary cryptographic mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
